question: What siddhis arise in this context, including distant hearing and bond-paralysis?
premises: Knowledge of distant hearing is mentioned
These are presented as related attainments
inference: The practitioner gains knowledge of distant hearing and likewise the power to paralyze bonds.
uncertainties: pāśa-stobham may refer to immobilizing fetters or enemies
plain_english: O beloved, one gains knowledge of distant hearing and likewise the power to paralyze bonds.
